You can use the Persuasion skill to attempt to Bribe government officials or other individuals of influence. The Persuasion check DC depends on the perceived risk to the official's position (if the Bribe is discovered) modified by the nature of your request (how dangerous the request is and how much of a Bribe you're offering).
Request is within the official's regular duties.
Request is outside the officer's duties, but within their ability.
Request is outside official's duties, and not easily concealed.
Request is personally dangerous to official.
Bribery amount is double the going rate.
Bribery amount is quadruple the going rate.
Bribery amount is ten times the going rate or higher.

You can use the Persuasion skill to attempt to communicate with someone who does not understand your language or to nonverbally convey an idea (such as communicating silently with another hero while both of you are infiltrating an Imperial facility). As a
, you can attempt a Persuasion check to improvise communication with another being. The target must be able to see you, and you can communicate only simple concepts.
The check DC is equal to 20 minus the target's
modifier. If the target of your Improvised Communication has agreed upon signals for certain concepts in advance, reduce the Persuasion DC by 5.

Concepts that can be communicated include (but are not limited to) "Be quiet," "Go," "Hello," "Help," "I am hungry/thirsty," "Pick this up," "Put that down," "Stay here," "Stop," and "Thank you." The Gamemaster can allow other simple concepts to be communicated, as long as they can be easily communicated nonverbally.
